newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says banks should pass on rate cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says banks should pass on rate cut.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday that the banks should pass on the latest interest rate cut in full to home owners.
The Reserve Bank of Australia said earlier on Wednesday that it had cut the official cash rate by 50 basis points to 6.0 percent. It last cut rates on November 6, by the same amount.

"The reason why interest rates have been cut is to give benefits to consumers and the homebuyers -- not the banks. So this ought to be passed on to consumers, homebuyers and small business people," Costello said.
"I call on the banks to move and here is a real opportunity -- let's see which bank can be the most competitive."
